notes.title: ANIWARS Early Access Trailer now live!
notes.notes: [p]We're thrilled to finally share the official Early Access trailer for ANIWARS: Call of the Void![/p][p][/p][p]The trailer showcases all the three factions, intense tactical battles, and the first look at the action you'll experience when the game launches into Early Access later this year.[/p][previewyoutube="jmRFTUOWEuc;full"][/previewyoutube][p]If you like what you see, don't forget to wishlist on Steam and share the trailer with your friends! [/p][p]Or take part in the development on our Discord.[/p][p][/p][p]This is just the beginning - more updates, previews, and news are coming as we get closer to launch.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for all the support![/p][p]- Breaker Interactive[/p]
